motions.purpose: Make the link budget legible as a running sum: each slider change recomputes the waterfall from EIRP through losses to received margin, so the user sees which term dominates at each distance and band.
motions.model: Standard link-budget chain: antenna gains from aperture relations, free-space path loss, clear-air and rain attenuation, system noise temperature, Eb/N0 against the required rate; distances from the frozen MESAFELER table (LEO through deep space).
motions.limitations: Atmospheric terms are simplified fits rather than ITU-R tables; modulation is abstracted into a required Eb/N0, so coding gain and implementation loss are not itemized.
motions.reducedMotion: There is no autonomous animation: the chart only re-renders when the user changes an input, so behavior is identical under reduced motion.
motions.exportState: ?export=1 hides controls and footer; the SVG chart is deterministic for identical URL parameters.
motions.accessibility: Native sliders and selects; every bar in the waterfall is labeled with its dB value as text; the margin verdict is stated in a sentence, not only by color.
